name: LUCENT SERIES
description: Almost Heaven Saunas is introducing the Lucent Infrared Series. Classic, stylish, and compact, the Lucent Series is designed to please. This series displays a unique blend of the traditional sauna culture with the contemporary. Made with smooth hemlock, the Lucent gives off a traditional sauna feel, while the carbon fiber panels, chromotherapy lighting, and stainless-steel handle bring in the contemporary. The Lucent series also includes a digital audio system and an ionizer to help cleanse the air. If you are in the market for an infrared sauna, the Lucent Infrared Sauna will not disappoint.
